# ResizeMyImg

> > Free online image editor for resizing, cropping, compressing, and converting images to JPG, PNG, and GIF formats

ResizeMyImg.com is a browser-based image manipulation tool developed by WebFactory Ltd that supports batch processing and multiple output formats. The service is available in multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Russian.

## Key Topics

- Image resizing
- Image compression
- Format conversion (JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG)
- Crop images
- Batch image processing
- Online image editor
- Image rotation
- Social media templates
- Browser-based tool
- Free image resizer
- Image format converter
- WebFactory Ltd
- No upload limits

## Core Tools

- [Online Image Resizer to edit, crop and resize images for free](https://resizemyimg.com): Homepage: free online tool to resize, crop, edit & convert images
- [Free Online Bulk Image Resizer](https://resizemyimg.com/multiple): Bulk image resizer for batch processing multiple images at once

## International Versions

- [Redimensionador de Imágenes Online para editar y recortar](https://resizemyimg.com/es): Spanish version: resize, crop, compress & convert to JPG/PNG/GIF
- [Redimensionnement d'image en ligne pour éditer et recadrer](https://resizemyimg.com/fr): French version: resize, crop, rotate, compress & convert images online
- [Kostenlosen Bearbeiten und Zuschneiden von Bildern und Änderung ihrer Größe](https://resizemyimg.com/de): German version: resize, crop, edit & convert to JPG/PNG/GIF formats
- [Ridimensionatore di Immagini Online per modificare e ritagliare](https://resizemyimg.com/it): Italian version: resize, crop, edit, rotate & convert to JPG/PNG/GIF
- [Redimensionador de Imagens Online para editar e cortar](https://resizemyimg.com/pt): Portuguese version: resize, crop, edit & convert to JPG/PNG/GIF
- [Онлайн редактор изображений для редактирования и обрезания](https://resizemyimg.com/ru): Russian version: resize, crop, rotate, compress & convert images online
